success.description: Sufficient power (see below), an enemy within close range suffers a critical wound - Special: When an enemy within close range suffers a critical wound, you may immediately spend power equal to that critical wound’s severity. Then, place 3 recharge tokens on this card to cast this spell and ignite the target’s blood, dealing additional wounds {Dc} to the target equal to the severity of that critical wound
